Example Lakeside Merit Award

The Example Lakeside Fund supports high-school seniors who want to go on to university.

Eligibility

Applicants need a minimum GPA of 3.5.

Applicants without a GPA may send a SAT score of at least 1400 in its place.

Benefits

Selected students receive USD 2,500 a year.

How to apply

Fill in the online form on this page and upload your documents before the closing date. Shortlisted applicants are invited to an interview with the selection panel, and the results are announced on this page.
